name: slack
changelog: v1: a Slack adapter for agents — Socket Mode (no public URL), DMs, mentions and the threads the agent is in, the assistant pane, /agent; replies posted in the thread they answer
title: Slack
description: Connects a Slack app to an agent built from the agent template: people DM the bot, mention it in channels or use Slack's assistant pane, and the agent answers — each DM and thread its own conversation. Uses Socket Mode, so the workspace needs no public URL.
